newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential ups Dell to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential ups Dell to buy.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Don Young said he raised his rating on Dell Computer Corp to buy from hold.

-- Young said he raised his earnings estimate for the fiscal year ending January 1998 to $3.65 from $3.13 per share based on the computermaker's move to capture more of the midsize corporate account market.
-- The analyst said he set a 12-month target price in the range of $65 to $70.
-- He said the price target was based on 16 times price to earnings multiple, plus $8 a share of excess cash the company has on hand, which he expects to see used in a share buyback.
